headline: US Online Holiday Spending Hits Record $7.1 Billion on Thanksgiving
summary: U.S. online spending rose 10.4% year-on-year to a record $7.1 billion on Thanksgiving, exceeding Adobe's forecast, driven by gaming and electronics.
why: Holiday e-commerce sales figures offer early indicators of consumer demand and retail sector performance during the peak shopping season.

impacts.name: Retail and E-commerce
impacts.why: Record online spending directly boosts revenue for digital retailers and e-commerce platforms.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
